items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And Alfred Lewis played bass. Yes. And Eddie Robertson drumming myself.

ctx.x: Two Matthews boys, one of them today, another boy named White. Name was Buller White. And Alfred Lewis played bass. Yes. And Eddie Robertson drumming myself. 된된된 된 된
What did you play first? In the band? Yeah. Val Trombone.
